stem.text: A copper wire hangs vertically from a fixed point. A load is attached to the lower end of the wire producing an extension $x$. The wire obeys Hooke's law.
Which single change gives an extension $2x$?

A.text: Halve the cross-sectional area of the wire.

B.text: Halve the diameter of the wire.

C.text: Halve the length of the wire.

D.text: Halve the load on the wire.
